name: What factors can cause damage to a concrete driveway?

mainEntity.name: What factors can cause damage to a concrete driveway?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several factors contribute to concrete driveway damage. Freeze-thaw cycles can cause cracks and spalling, though this is less common in Las Vegas. More significant local factors include expansive soils, which can lead to uneven settling; heavy vehicle loads exceeding the concrete's capacity; improper drainage causing water accumulation; tree root growth; and poor installation, such as inadequate sub-base preparation or insufficient curing. Chemical spills and lack of sealing can also degrade the surface.
acceptedAnswer.description: Damage can be caused by heavy loads, improper drainage, tree roots, expansive soils, poor installation, and lack of sealing.
